references.text: Psalm 23:5 describes how God anoints David with oil, which can be seen as a parallel to the anointing of Jesus with costly oil in Matthew 26:7.
In Exodus 30:23-25 it is described how holy anointing oil should be made, which can be connected to the use of costly oil to anoint Jesus.
In Mark 14:3 Jesus is also anointed with costly oil by a woman, which is a direct parallel event to what is described in Matthew 26:7.
John 12:3 tells of a similar event where Mary anoints Jesus' feet with nard oil, pointing to the practice of anointing important persons.
